fieldValues.title: RFC-034: declared childContainerIds nesting, retire contains-traversal membership
fieldValues.summary: srs-rust#970 implements accepted RFC-034 (Container Structure and Nesting): Container.childContainerIds, effective(C) as the recursive closure over declared root/member/child edges, and removes the pre-RFC-034 I-66 condition-3 contains-Relation traversal from membership entirely.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from the srs-rust gate:pool queue via srs#580 (coordinator dispatch comment 2026-09-06T16:18Z). Fix in srs-rust PR #974: container_service::member_ids replaced by direct_member_ids (RFC-034 [R1], containerScope explicit) and effective_member_ids (recursive closure via childContainerIds, containerScope subtree / RFC-012 containerId / containers_for_instance / container resolve-view). require_valid_child_containers enforces [R7] (existence, distinctness, acyclicity) at write time. render_service subtree stub replaced with the real implementation; explicit scope fixed to use direct(C) instead of accidentally inheriting the deep scope. Schema mirrors updated to match already-accepted RFC-034 content in srs canonical, which also fixed the repo-wide Schema Drift CI failure. cargo build/test/clippy all green; one pre-existing environment-only failure (rfc_035_parity against a non-master srs sibling) confirmed unrelated.
